services.name: 3 Hour - EARTH DAY UTV Clean-Up Adventure - 50% OFF
services.desc: Westcreek - Earth Day UTV Adventure & Forest Clean-Up Join us for a special afternoon of fun and help pick up litter while on a trail ride in Pike National Forest. This event is sponsored by Focus on the Forest and Great Outdoors Adventures (GOA). Your 3 hour adventure is provided by GOA at 1/2 price as our way of saying thank you for helping us clean the trails and campsites while on your ride. When you get back from 3 hours of fun, The Grilled Cheese Food Truck will have a delicious hot sandwich and drinks waiting for you! The Earth Day Celebration will be held at GOA's private trailhead. The trail ride and clean-up will start from here and you'll ride directly on to National Forest

services.name: WOODLAND PARK: Polaris Slingshot
services.desc: Explore in Style Tour some of the most scenic highways in the Pikes Peak region in style. Ride to destinations like Pikes Peak Summit, Cripple Creek, Platte River Canyon, Colorado Springs, Mount Princeton Hot Springs, and many more. Rides start and end at the GOA store in Woodland Park. Rates Two Hour Rental: $307.67 Four Hour Rental: $387.43 Six Hour Rental: $461.50 One Day Rental: $507.08 Two Day Rental: $883.11 About A custom Slingshot tour map with the best routes and destinations will be provided on a GPS tablet computer for your ride, or use the on-board Polaris Ride Command GPS navigation to easily find your way around and your way home! Slingshots also have amazing bluetooth stereos

services.name: WOODLAND PARK: 5 Seat Jeep Gladiator

services.name: 2 Hour - Guided UTV or Jeep Sunset Wildlife Tour
services.desc: Guided Sunset Wildlife Tour Enjoy watching beautiful Colorado sunsets from an amazing scenic overlook while capturing golden memories. Your guide will create a complimentary video capturing the whole experience including photos, videos and a 3D map of the tour route! You will explore beautiful landscapes with the chance to view Mule Deer, Rocky Mountain Elk, and Shiras Moose! Your guide will lead you through the many National Forest trails and make sure everyone stays together. Our professional guides will do everything they can to create a safe tour you will not forget.
